_note: Register fragment for woo-value-list-curation (REQ-WVL-001). valueListChoice holds what the organisation owns about one entry of a national value list: its order, its own label, its explanation, and whether it is hidden or active. The normative fields (code, URI, the source's label) stay with the list and are refreshed from the source; ValueListChoiceListener refuses a choice that sets one, and ValueListView merges the two.

valueListChoice.comment: The organisation's choices about one value-list entry. A refresh of the list never reads or writes it

valueListChoice.title: Value list choice
valueListChoice.summary: How this organisation uses one entry of a national value list
valueListChoice.description: The national value lists are the same for every organisation; how an organisation uses them is not. A choice holds, for one entry of one list, the order it is offered in, the organisation's own label and explanation, and whether it is hidden or active. The code, the URI and the source's label are not here: they come from the list and are refreshed from it, and a choice that tries to set one is refused.

scheme.title: List
scheme.description: The value list the entry belongs to, by the name the value-lists page uses, e.g. informatiecategorieen.

entry.title: Entry
entry.description: The URI of the list entry this choice is about.

order.title: Order
order.description: Where the entry is offered in pick lists, lowest first. Entries without an order follow in the list's own order.

localLabel.title: Own label
localLabel.description: The label this organisation shows instead of the source's. Left empty, the source's label is shown.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: What the entry means, in this organisation's words, for a citizen choosing a filter.

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.description: Leave the entry out of pick lists and the public filter.

active.title: Active
active.description: For the organisation list: this installation publishes for this organisation.
